N° 06A French saga, an essay and an encyclopedia2026

1884

A regime invented in the real Cameroon, from the treaty signed on the Wouri in 1884 to a new social contract: a five-book saga of about 365,000 words to read online, opened by an illustrated essay on the African problem and closed by an encyclopedia.

Visit the site ↗How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Books about how African regimes hold on to power are written for scholars, and novels about them are rare, short or never read where they are set. Readers at home know the slogans, the paid crowds, the motions of support and the bought exams from daily life, but nobody has put the whole machine on one page, in their language, with the history that made it.

02

What it does

The home page names the African problem in seven words, philosophy, history, organized stupidity, lack of creativity, black face and white mask, failed politics and DNA, each with its own artwork, over a cloth that changes as you scroll. The saga follows a speechwriter who writes the voice of a president nobody has seen in years, a captain who refuses to fire, a young presenter who leads the regime's marches by day and the resistance by night, and a midwife in Maroua, through an election, a massacre, prison and a revolution without a shot fired by the people. It reads one chapter at a time, with adjustable text and a paper or night page. The encyclopedia gathers every character, institution, place, ritual and word, and holds the 3D timeline, the 3D map, the regime's fourteen rules against the people's fourteen answers, and what is real and what is invented.

03

How it is built

A static site with no build step on Vercel, generated by Python scripts from the manuscript: Markdown chapters become HTML with French typography, then each chapter is stored on its own and loaded only when opened. Every pattern, symbol and figure is drawn in SVG from code, and Three.js r128 draws the cloths, the railway and the map, with a plain fallback when 3D is not available. Real paths for every chapter and section, reduced motion respected, text sized for phones first. No real living person and no real party appears in the novel.
